null_semantics: Unknown, not supplied or not applicable as described by status/notes; never silently zero.

id_namespaces.M-FILE: listed or requested file, not proof of release
id_namespaces.M-RAW: Released sequence reads, alignment derivatives or indexes, distinct from source-file identity
id_namespaces.M-RELEASE: Prepared processed call or expression file

coordinate_convention: 1-based position with explicit build and reference/alternate alleles. Original audit representation retained; not freshly normalized.
count_convention: alternate_count / reference_plus_alternate_count. Different count methods are labelled; 0/0 means no informative coverage.
filter_convention: A literal dot is an unset filter field, not standardized PASS.
date_convention: ISO calendar dates when known; precision stated separately.
release_convention: Original logical_bytes describe inventoried inputs. Raw and processed release catalogues describe actual public derivatives and their exact bytes/hashes. Large sequencing, processed calls and DICOM archives are hosted separately; curated tables remain in the ZIP. Unknown provenance is explicit. Raw-read and alignment-record counts are not interchangeable.

evidence_classes.previous_clinical_report_extraction: Previously read source report; not newly OCR-verified in this build.
evidence_classes.previous_research_report_extraction: Previously extracted research report; not a validated clinical result.
evidence_classes.selected_locus_research_audit: Limited read/call inspection; not an exhaustive or clinical variant reinterpretation.
evidence_classes.patient_report_pending_records: Patient account with confirmatory source records requested.

read_quality_limits: Direct audit counts used MAPQ >=30, locus BQ >=20 and standard mapping/duplicate/QC exclusions; exact CIGAR support for indels. Counts of distinct pair names are only fragment proxies. Neither RNA support nor predicted sequence proves protein presentation or immune recognition.
